overview.zh: 适合第一次入境中国旅行者的国际门户，历史文化景点密集。
overview.en: A major international gateway with a dense concentration of historic sites.

provider.zh: 中国气象局公共气象服务
provider.en: China Meteorological Administration public weather service

note.zh: 查看北京实时预报后，再到中央气象台核验全国及区域预警。
note.en: Check Beijing's live forecast, then review national and regional alerts from the National Meteorological Center.

name.en: Beijing Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism

operator.en: Beijing Municipal Bureau of Culture and Tourism

use_for.zh: 查看文旅新闻、公共服务、旅游信息和景区公告。
use_for.en: Use for culture and tourism news, public services, visitor information, and attraction notices.

notes.zh: 本项目不保存实时路线和运营时间，请使用当地官方交通来源核验。
notes.en: Live routes and service hours are intentionally not stored; use an official local transport source.

tradeoff.zh: 前往历史景点方便，但通常更拥挤、住宿价格也可能更高。
tradeoff.en: Convenient for historic sights; often busier and more expensive.

tradeoff.zh: 餐饮和夜生活选择丰富，但前往部分老城景点时间较长。
tradeoff.en: Broad dining and nightlife choice; longer trips to some old-city sights.

clothing.zh: 分层穿着并准备轻便防风外套。
clothing.en: Layers and a light windproof jacket.

clothing.zh: 分层穿着，深秋增加保暖外套。
clothing.en: Layers; add a warm jacket later in the season.

clothing.zh: 保暖外套、手套和保暖鞋。
clothing.en: Insulated coat, gloves, and warm shoes.

dietary_notes.zh: 请询问酱料配方和过敏原。

ticket.note: Check the official ticket page; prices and policies can change.

booking.note: Confirm passport reservation rules and release windows on the official site.

summary.zh: 大型宫殿建筑群与博物馆。
summary.en: A vast palace complex and museum.

accessibility.note: Confirm current accessible routes before visiting.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的故宫博物院。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to the Palace Museum entry in Beijing's official list.

ticket.note: Park and attraction tickets may be separate; verify officially.

booking.note: Confirm current reservation rules before visiting.

summary.zh: 以明清祭天建筑群闻名的大型公园。
summary.en: A large park known for its Ming and Qing ceremonial architecture.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的天坛公园。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Temple of Heaven Park in Beijing's official list.

ticket.note: Entry and paid interior sites may use separate tickets; verify officially.

booking.note: Confirm passport booking and entry rules before the visit.

summary.zh: 以昆明湖、万寿山和皇家园林建筑组成的大型世界遗产景区，适合预留半天。
summary.en: A large World Heritage imperial garden around Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill; allow at least half a day.

accessibility.note: Lakeside routes are easier than hill routes; confirm current accessible entrances.

note.zh: 静态数据不确认当天开放状态，请查官方公告。
note.en: Static data does not confirm same-day operations; check official notices.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的颐和园。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to the Summer Palace in Beijing's official list.

ticket.note: Some ruins or exhibition areas may require separate tickets.

booking.note: Verify current entry rules on the official channel.

summary.zh: 以清代皇家园林遗址、湖区和展陈为核心的大型遗址公园。
summary.en: A large archaeological park centered on Qing imperial-garden ruins, lakes, and exhibitions.

note.zh: 开放区域和展陈可能调整，请出发前核验。
note.en: Open zones and exhibitions may change; verify before travel.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的圆明园景区。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to the Old Summer Palace scenic area in Beijing's official list.

ticket.note: Verify the current ticket price and eligible identity documents.

booking.note: Confirm real-name reservation rules and release windows.

summary.zh: 由清代王府建筑与花园组成的博物馆景区，巷区步行衔接方便。
summary.en: A museum complex of Qing mansion architecture and gardens, convenient for a hutong-area walking day.

warnings: Closed days and hours may change

note.zh: 请核验当日开放、闭馆日和预约要求。
note.en: Verify same-day opening, closure days, and booking rules.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的恭王府景区。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Prince Kung's Mansion in Beijing's official list.

ticket.note: Public outdoor areas are generally free; individual venues and events may charge.

booking.note: Venue interiors and events have separate rules; verify each official operator.

summary.zh: 以鸟巢、水立方和中轴公共空间为核心的综合片区，室内场馆需单独安排。
summary.en: A broad district centered on the Bird's Nest, Water Cube, and axial public space; venue interiors need separate planning.

note.zh: 赛事和活动可能改变通行与场馆开放。
note.en: Events may change access and venue operations.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的奥林匹克公园整体景区，不代表每个场馆单独为 5A。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to the Olympic Park scenic area as a whole, not each venue individually.

ticket.note: Entry, shuttle, cableway, and slideway products may be separate.

booking.note: Verify passport purchase, transport, and last-entry rules.

summary.zh: 位于北京郊区的长城山地景区，需要把市区往返交通计入一整天。
summary.en: A mountainous Great Wall section outside central Beijing; plan a full day including transfers.

accessibility.note: Steep terrain and wall steps limit access; verify assisted routes.

note.zh: 天气可能影响缆车和山区开放，请当天核验。
note.en: Weather may affect mountain access and cableways; verify on the day.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的慕田峪长城景区。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to the Mutianyu Great Wall scenic area in Beijing's official list.

ticket.note: Park and interior-site tickets may differ; verify officially.

booking.note: Check current ticketing and last-entry rules.

summary.zh: 老城中心的皇家园林公园，可与景山或什刹海按片区组合。
summary.en: A central imperial garden that combines well with Jingshan or Shichahai by area.

note.zh: 请核验当天开放区域和游船运营。
note.en: Verify open zones and any boat operations for the day.

scope_note.zh: 等级对应北京市官方名录中的北海公园。
scope_note.en: The rating applies to Beihai Park in Beijing's official list.
